    Extending endpoint-polarized detector words #

    The ordered-word filtration grows a word at its source endpoint. This file packages its two legal one-letter extensions: a compatible incoming arrow is prefixed positively, while a compatible outgoing arrow is prefixed with its formal inverse. Both operations preserve the target polarization and increase word length strictly.
